snippet.title: Mycelium Conquest Trailer
snippet.description:
Mycelium Conquest is deep automation game where you grow a living mycelial network across an alien planet. Consume the local flora and creatures, build biological production chains, and evolve from a tiny spore into a cosmic entity that consumes worlds.

Wishlist on Steam!
